# Local model OCR fixture

`local-llm-notice.png` is an original synthetic notice created for this project's
tests. It contains no source capture or official publication. Its text is:

```text
COMUNE DI ESEMPIO
ALLERTA METEO
CIMITERI COMUNALI CHIUSI
DALLE ORE 18.00 DEL 02/10/2026
FINO ALLE ORE 08.00 DEL 03/10/2026
```

The image was rasterized at 144 DPI from a one-page synthetic PDF with ordinary
sans-serif text. It is redistributable under this repository's license.
